params.question: The drawing dimensions the lobe x-offset as 12 but never gives the lobe y-offset or the overall height directly.
params.method: Solved from the R100 tangency chain. The R100 arc is internally tangent to both the Ø80 hub and the R10 boss, so its center P satisfies |P| = 100 - 40 = 60 and |P - L| = 100 - 10 = 90 where L = (12, H). A least-squares circle fit to the traced left-flank profile pixels placed P at (58.57, 0.44) - i.e. essentially exactly on the +X axis at (60, 0). Setting P = (60, 0) gives |P - L| = sqrt((60-12)^2 + H^2) = 90.
params.note: The designer's intent was almost certainly to place the R100 center exactly on the horizontal centerline at (60, 0), which makes the R100 arc tangent to the hub exactly at (-40, 0) on the horizontal centerline. This is independently confirmed by the pixel scan across the center row, where BOTH left and right outer profile points measured exactly 40.0 mm from the center.

=== RESOLUTION OF THE FIVE LISTED AMBIGUITIES ===

(a) 3-LOBE BASE? -> NO. RESOLVED: the base is a TWO-LOBE (2-lobe) S-shaped/crank link, not 3-lobe and not a plain Ø108 flange. There is no Ø108 anywhere. The correct base is a Ø80 central hub with exactly TWO opposed R10 lobes at (12, +76.1315) and (-12, -76.1315), joined by R100 convex outer arcs and R35 concave fillets. Lobe radii = R10; lobe centers as given; the connecting arc radii/centers are R100 about (+/-60, 0) and R35 about (+/-51.4823, +/-54.5403). The part has C2 point symmetry (180 deg rotation), NOT 3-fold 120 deg symmetry.

(b) 3x Ø10 MOUNTING HOLES? -> NO, there are exactly TWO Ø10 holes, not three. RESOLVED: they are NOT on a bolt-circle in the usual sense - they sit at the two lobe centers, at a pitch radius of 77.0714 mm from the origin (equivalently a Ø154.14 circle), positioned by the dimensioned x-offset of 12 mm plus the derived y-offset of 76.1315 mm. The two holes are 180 deg apart about the origin. Note the Ø10 callout IS on the drawing and IS correct - only the quantity (2, not 3) and the location were wrong in the skeleton.

(c) CENTRAL TOWER Ø32/Ø19 vs Ø25 neck / Ø19 bore? -> BOTH WRONG. RESOLVED: there is no tower/neck at all - this is a flat plate, not a stepped shaft. The central feature is a hub of OD Ø80 with a Ø40 through-bore, 20 mm thick. Exact tower OD = 80.0 mm (Ø80), exact bore = 40.0 mm (Ø40). Neither Ø32, Ø19, nor Ø25 appears on the drawing.

(d) 2x 45 DEG CHAMFER LOCATIONS? -> RESOLVED: THERE ARE NO CHAMFERS. No 45 deg callout, no chamfer callout, and no chamfer geometry exists on this drawing. I verified this by pixel-scanning the side view: every transition (the 20 mm hub band to the 10 mm web, and the web to the 20 mm boss bands) is a SQUARE STEP with a sharp 90 deg shoulder - the scanned edges are perfectly vertical/horizontal with no angled segments. The '2x 45 deg chamfer' in the skeleton is spurious. The only two 'paired features' that could have been misread as chamfers are the two 5 mm square steps per side where the 20 mm hub/boss thickness drops to the 10 mm web.

(e) OVERALL HEIGHT? -> RESOLVED as 172.263 mm (derived, NOT dimensioned on the drawing). Derivation: 2 * (76.1315 + 10). Independently pixel-measured at 172.23 mm - agreement within 0.03 mm. If a round design value is preferred, the closest clean intent would be 172.26; but the exact analytic value sqrt(5796) + 10 doubled = 172.263 is what the tangency construction produces. Overall width is 80.0 mm and overall thickness is 20.0 mm.

=== METHOD & CONFIDENCE ===
Despite the low-resolution thumbnail, all nine callouts were legible and every derived value was independently cross-validated by direct pixel measurement of the 1998x1560 raster. Scale was established at 8.175 px/mm from the Ø40 bore and Ø80 hub (two independent measurements agreeing to 0.3%), with the front-view center located at pixel (561.0, 833.5). Cross-checks that passed: hub Ø measured 79.9 (nominal 80); bore Ø measured 40.0 (nominal 40); boss Ø measured 19.94 (nominal 20); hole Ø measured 9.91 (nominal 10); lobe offset measured (11.93, 76.15) and (-11.99, -76.15) versus nominal (+/-12, +/-76.1315); R100 least-squares fit returned R=98.7 centered 58.57 mm from origin versus the exact construction R=100 at 60 mm; R35 traced points measured 34.78-34.87 mm from the computed center versus nominal 35; thicknesses measured 19.94 and 9.91 versus nominal 20 and 10; overall height measured 172.23 versus derived 172.263.

EXPLICITLY UNCERTAIN / FLAGGED ITEMS: (1) the lobe y-offset 76.1315 and the overall height 172.263 are DERIVED from tangency, not dimensioned - they are geometrically forced by the R100 construction and confirmed to 0.03 mm by measurement, but a designer's rounded intent of y=76 (overall 172.0) cannot be fully excluded from a thumbnail (est, low risk); (2) the surface-finish roughness values on the two hub-face flags are UNREADABLE; (3) the small crossed-square symbol between the views is UNREADABLE in purpose and is flagged for human review - it carries no dimensional content.

BUILD RECOMMENDATION: model as a 2D profile (the 8-arc closed loop above) extruded 20 mm symmetric about Z=0, then remove material to leave the 10 mm web: pocket both faces by 5 mm everywhere except within R40 of the origin (the hub) and within R10 of each lobe center (the bosses). Finally cut the Ø40 central bore and the two Ø10 lobe holes through all. Discard the supplied skeleton entirely.
